## Testing Mode: UPDATE

Wire detect-session-leakage.sh into SKILL.md Phase F.
SKILL.md is agent guidance prose — exempt from DD6 per CLAUDE.md: 'For non-code changes (skills, CLAUDE.md, agent guidance), skip this step.'

## Story DD Coverage
DD1, DD2, DD3, DD4 (integration context)

## File to modify
plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md

## Change needed

In Phase F, after all story branches have been merged (merge-story-branch.sh calls complete) and before marking the story closed, add:

```bash
# Leakage detection: catches non-merge commits that bypassed check-session-merge-only.sh
if ! bash "$PLUGIN_SCRIPTS/detect-session-leakage.sh"; then
  echo 'ERROR: Leakage detector found bypass commits — story closure halted. See recovery options above.' >&2
  # Do NOT auto-close the story; surface the error for user resolution
  exit 1
fi
```

If detector exits non-zero: Phase F halts story closure and surfaces the detector's stderr (which already contains named recovery options) to the user. Story remains open until user resolves.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] detect-session-leakage.sh call added to Phase F at the correct position (after merge-story-branch.sh, before story closure)
- [ ] Failure handling: non-zero exit from detector halts story closure
- [ ] Integration comment included: 'Leakage detection: catches non-merge commits that bypassed check-session-merge-only.sh'
- [ ] Existing Phase F structure preserved — no other changes
- [ ] SKILL.md non-code exemption documented: 'SKILL.md is agent guidance — exempt from DD6 per CLAUDE.md non-code change rule'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
